property_summary: mintSynth must not revert when the caller has deposited fresh LP tokens into the pool
The call c.mintSynth(member, amount) must not revert.
c.mintSynth(member, amount) must not revert.
c.mintSynth(member, amount) must not revert.
mintSynth must not revert when called by an authorized pool with a valid member and positive amount.

After any sequence of calls ending with allowance(...), for any curated pool that previously called mintSynth, the mapSynth_LPBalance must be non-decreasing (i.e., >= prior value); the mutant fails to increment it, so at least one key's balance is lower than what the correct contract maintains.

For any curated pool that calls mintSynth after receiving LP tokens, the subsequent allowance query to an external party must succeed; the bug causes the LP balance tracking to be out of sync, leading to a revert in burnSynth during a logical allowance check.

For any curated pool p that calls mintSynth after receiving LP tokens, the mapSynth_LPBalance[p] recorded by the contract must be non-decreasing; the mutant omits incrementing the pool's LP balance, so after the call mapSynth_LPBalance[p] is strictly less than the correct contract's value.
mintSynth must increase the debt tracking for the calling pool to keep the LP-to-debt ratio consistent, otherwise a second mintSynth will revert.
c.mintSynth must not revert when called.
mintSynth must not revert when called by a curated pool with a non-zero amount.
mintSynth(member, amount) must not revert when called by a curated pool with a non-zero amount.
c.mintSynth(member, amount) must succeed without reverting when called by a curated pool.

After mintSynth, the ratio mapSynth_LPBalance / mapSynth_LPDebt should always be equal to the ratio of total LP balance to total debt for any pool; the bug makes the denominator constant so the invariant breaks.

For any two addresses a and b and any allowance amount, calling allowance(a,b) does not change mapSynth_LPBalance of any pool; the buggy version also doesn't change it through allowance alone, but after mintSynth the ratio mapSynth_LPBalance/mapSynth_LPDebt is inflated relative to the correct version.

After any sequence of calls, the mapSynth_LPBalance for each pool must equal the total LP tokens deposited into the synth for that pool; the bug skips incrementing mapSynth_LPDebt, so the tracked LP balance equals deposits while the debt is permanently zero, causing mapSynth_LPBalance to exceed the zero debt for any non-zero mint.

For any pool and any nonzero amount minted via mintSynth, calling allowance does not change the ratio mapSynth_LPBalance[pool] / mapSynth_LPDebt[pool]; the buggy version leaves mapSynth_LPDebt[pool] unchanged, so the ratio inflates beyond the correct contract's ratio after the first mint.

For any pool that has ever called mintSynth, calling allowance should not change the value of mapSynth_LPDebt[pool]; the buggy version fails to increment it during mintSynth, causing the debt to remain zero forever even after mints have occurred.
mintSynth never reverts when called by an address that has already minted some synth and the pool has deposited some LP tokens

property_summary: mintSynth should never revert when called from a valid pool with sufficient LP collateral.
A call to c.mintSynth(member, 1) must not revert.
mintSynth() must never revert when called with any address and amount 1.
mintSynth should never revert when called by a curated pool

After any sequence ending in a call to mintSynth, mapSynth_LPBalance for the pool remains equal to the pool's LP token balance held by the synth contract. The bug adds a constant offset, breaking this equality.

For any pool that calls mintSynth, the increase in mapSynth_LPBalance for that pool must equal the actual increase in LP token balance of the synth contract. The bug adds a constant +1 offset, so the balance will eventually exceed the actual held LP tokens by at least the number of mintSynth calls.
